text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky had been running through the 
Junior-class races at a leisurely pace. 
But then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
King Halo and Special Week appear to 
declare war.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since Grass Wonder and El Condor Pasa are 
taking different paths, these two will be 
rivals for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky finally gets up off her feet. 
Her next goal is the first leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown, the "Satsuki Sho".
